name: Nóatún
description:
Nóatún is a ve(3,3) exchange for wRATR on Alephium — the harbour where wRATR's price of record is set.

Trade wRATR against ALPH, dollars or xALPH. Lock wRATR for a share of every trade's fee and the vote that steers where emissions go. Add liquidity, stake it in the gauge, and earn the weekly stream.

What makes it different: the emissions mint nothing. There is no protocol token, and nothing in the contracts can issue one — every wRATR paid out was mined first on RATR's own proof-of-work chain, funded from the Ratatoskr masternode fleet's income. The weekly stream tapers 1% an epoch against a fixed lifetime cap, and the contract that books it has no drain, no owner withdrawal, and no way to raise a week's budget above what is already in the pot.

Every figure on the dashboard is read live from the chain, depth included. None of them is a promise.
short_description: ve(3,3) DEX for wRATR, paid by masternodes.
